name: @stackra/oxlint-config
purpose: Workspace oxlint config preset — shared lint rules across @stackra/* packages, services, and workers.
capabilities: base + react + native + nest + worker presets
Consumed via package export specifiers in .oxlintrc.json
Built-in oxlint plugins — no ESLint runtime dependency tree
when_to_use: Every package/app/service/worker consumes a preset for uniform oxlint behaviour.
when_not_to_use: Workspaces with intentionally-different rules extend + override locally.
